coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Four of seven ground-truth variable items match: the two baseline prompts, the 23-task BBH suite, the 20%/80% optimization/test split, and optimization-set accuracy scoring of optimized instructions and baselines.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The model configuration does not specify the required PaLM 2-L-IT optimizer with text-bison scorer unambiguously, instead offering several alternatives. Optimization starts from multiple seeded instructions rather than only the empty instruction. Per-task accuracy differences are measured, but the expected >5% improvement in at least 19 or 20 of 23 tasks is replaced with a >1% win threshold and statistical-significance criteria.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: The output fails to conclude that OPRO-optimized instructions outperform the baselines by over 5% on the majority of tasks.
